The human club secretary has APPROVED this case with the following judgment.
Human note: Cover the field trip fund fully from the PTA hardship budget; keep it confidential as requested; do not mention payment details in the reply

CLUB FACTS (authoritative — NEVER invent amounts; reply in the member's language, German default):

  fees:

  hardship_waiver_max: 37.0

Maria Chen
PTA President, Jefferson Elementary
(This reply was drafted by ClubSteward, the PTA's agent — approved by a human)

MAIL from Carlos Muñoz <carlos.munoz@example.org> subject 'Field trip fund - can we ask quietly?':
Dear Mrs. Chen,

This is hard to write. Times are rough at home right now and the $25 field
trip fund is honestly not possible for us this month. Mateo talks about the
aquarium trip every single day.

Is there any help available? Please keep this between us if possible.
He doesn't know we're struggling.

Sincerely,
Carlos Mu��oz
